record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, change each NextItNet block’s residual update from residual+y to residual+0.5*y. Fixed residual damping may preserve item identity through six causal convolution blocks while limiting accumulated convolution noise on short histories. Keep dilations, channels, kernels, normalization, features, embeddings, sequence selection, readout, scoring, loss and optimizer unchanged. Apply the same block definition during training and prediction, with one checkpoint per category.
